assurance_semantics.notes: IAM-3 issues strong step-up evidence only. Consumer proofs (SMS/Email OTP, device passkeys) are IAM-2 and MUST NOT satisfy strong assurance checks.

constitutional_invariants: IAM-3-INV-AAL2-STRONG-ONLY: All IAM-3 step-up grants MUST map to strong assurance only (aal2_strong or aal3). IAM-3 MUST NOT mint consumer proof grants.

IAM-3-INV-ADMIN-SCOPE-ONLY: Step-up grants (strong assurance) MAY ONLY be issued for privileged actors (org-scoped or platform-scoped actor_kinds). Consumer-only actors MUST NOT be able to obtain IAM-3 grants.

IAM-3-INV-PASSKEY-NOT-STRONG-BY-DEFAULT: WebAuthn 'passkeys' enrolled via consumer flows (IAM-2) MUST NOT be treated as IAM-3 factors. Only explicitly enrolled admin-grade WebAuthn hardware keys (IAM-3) may mint strong grants.

IAM-3-INV-REVOCATION-EPOCH: An actor_assurance_epoch integer MUST be incremented on MFA factor revoke/reset, recovery-code use, and critical role changes. Sessions and step-up grants MUST carry the epoch at issuance; epoch mismatch MUST immediately invalidate grants and downgrade assurance.

IAM-3-INV-DELEGATED-RESET-TIMELOCK: Admin MFA resets MUST use a time-locked reset request (default 1 hour) with approval by another privileged actor at aal2_strong, preventing instant takeover during recovery.

dependencies.reason: Schema-ref token authority parity (normalized schema_ref literal uses EVT-2 token).
IAM-1 is the session lifecycle producer IAM-3 semantics bind to.

mfa_reset_request.purpose: Time-locked delegated reset workflow for org/platform admins who lost a factor.

summary: IAM-3 defines strong-assurance (admin/high-value) MFA factor semantics and step-up grants. Non-producer: no EVT bus emissions.
title: Strong Assurance Vault (Admin & High-Value Only)
